name: Master Endmore
title: First Master of the Scour
role: First Master of the Scour — licenses every demolition in the city and asks every one of them the same question first
appearance: A compact woman in a dust-grey work coat with a surveyor's cord at her belt, who looks at every building as if measuring where it would fall.
voiceHints: Asks 'should this end?' so often it has become her greeting. Precise about load and weight. Laughs at a good demolition the way other people laugh at a joke.
wants: For every ending in the world to be asked for, and done well.
fears: The day the question stops being asked in the Scour, as it stopped up the road.
knowledge: How to bring down anything without harming what stands beside it
How far the Scouring is from the city, and how fast it is coming

reactsToReputation.any: asks what you want ended, and why
reactsToReputation.reckless: asks you, pointedly, whether you should end

questSeeds: Someone brought a living person to the Clearing Ground to be ended, and had a good reason
The Scouring has taken a quarter of the Worn Yard, and the Masters cannot agree whether to fight
_domainsWhy: endings done as a craft, the weight of stone, and the plain question she asks
